subject: ela
intro: Pick how the parts build the structure.

items.prompt:
The FIRST chapter of a story usually:
A) resolves everything
B) introduces characters and the problem
C) is the climax
items.answer: B) introduces characters and the problem

solution.answer: B) introduces characters and the problem

items.prompt:
The LAST chapter usually:
A) resolves the story
B) introduces new characters only
C) is the beginning

Each scene in a play should:
A) move the story forward
B) repeat the same event
C) stop the story

steps: Advance the plot. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Chapter 1 sets up a mystery; Chapters 2-4 gather clues; Chapter 5 solves it. Chapter 5:
A) resolves the story
B) introduces the problem
C) has nothing to do with the rest

steps: It ends the mystery. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Why are the 'gathering clues' chapters in the MIDDLE?
A) to develop the problem before the solution
B) to end the story early
C) for no reason
items.answer: A) to develop the problem before the solution

steps: Middle builds conflict. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to develop the problem before the solution

items.prompt:
In a poem, several stanzas together:
A) build on each other to develop the poem
B) are unrelated
C) must all rhyme the same
items.answer: A) build on each other to develop the poem

steps: Stanzas build the whole. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) build on each other to develop the poem

items.prompt:
A story's chapters go: peaceful town, a threat appears, the hero prepares, the final battle, the town rebuilds. The 'final battle' chapter is the:
A) setup
B) climax (turning point)
C) introduction

steps: The peak of conflict. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Why does the ORDER of chapters matter to a story's structure?
A) Each part builds on earlier ones, so out-of-order parts would be confusing
B) Order never matters
C) Only the first chapter matters
items.answer: A) Each part builds on earlier ones, so out-of-order parts would be confusing

steps: Structure depends on order. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Each part builds on earlier ones, so out-of-order parts would be confusing
